intro.subtitle: What the identified counterparties analysis will look like
intro.description: This section will automatically identify counterparties in deal documents, cross-reference them with external and internal data sources, and build a workspace for legal and due diligence analysis.

detection.description: The system finds counterparties in text, tables, appendices, and other deal materials.

verification.description: Found entities are linked to global, local, and internal data sources.

legal.description: The user receives a consolidated view, counterparty list, and detail panel for the selected entity.
